description: MEID, the CDMA equipment id. Hex is 14 digits with an optional Luhn check in base 16. Decimal is 18 digits (manufacturer and serial) with an optional decimal Luhn check, and it converts to the hex form. A 14-digit hex number that is only decimal digits is an IMEI, not a MEID. Spaces and hyphens are ignored. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: GET https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/meid-validate
name: meid_validate
title: Meid Validate
